status: Synthetic static fixture; no transport, stock or hardware qualification

shelf_margin_x.description: Side allowance around the source-derived carrier footprint

shelf_margin_front.description: Front allowance beyond the carrier base; handle may overhang

shelf_margin_back.description: Rear allowance beyond the carrier base

place_gap.description: Clear separation between the two fixed support footprints

nest_clearance.description: Unqualified lateral/rear carrier clearance inside the handover nest

nest_guide_h.description: Low guide height below the source hood and carrier handle

limitations: Exactly one closed RNA carrier is selected from the unchanged pinned K01 construction; the two cases are alternative static placements, not two carriers.
Nine symbolic material envelopes preserve catalog identity and slot order; they are not real package counts, observed stock or samples.
The environment is explicitly unbounded; the shelf place and handover nest are local reference geometry, not a complete shelf installation.
All new dimensions and clearances are synthetic assumptions; actual measured dimensions remain null.
Native support/contact and static handle-space checks do not establish load capacity, tipping stability, retention or a real grasp.
The fixed nest has no actuator, sensor, latch or controller. No rail robot, connecting path, swept-volume or hardware execution is implemented.
K01 geometry is generated from its source, not from another CAD output. Source-parameter changes require regeneration of this static composition.
